title: With no saved view every setting uses its own default
custom_preconds: 1. Clear the browser's site data for the application (or use a fresh browser profile).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales By Customer report.
2. Read every filter, the sort, and the visible columns.
custom_expected:
1. Date range = This Month.
2. Product Type = "Parts & Service."
3. Location = your active location.
4. Customer filter = all customers selected (label "All customers").
5. Sort = Customer name ascending.
6. All nine toggleable columns visible.
